search_stop: One bounded A-F/global study; no validation improvement or no eligible candidate stops refinement. Engineering/audit error stops execution.
question: Can a bounded fixed x0352 neighborhood improve robust 24-session outcomes under identical measured competition rules?
hypothesis: Nearby daily signal/allocation parameters improve median and lower-tail episode returns without reducing measured feasibility.
adoption_rule: 100% measured pass AND completeness in FULL development and validation, validation median and P25 not worse than baseline; stable neighborhood required. Unknown official evidence always BLOCK_SUBMISSION.
stop_condition: Stop on any engineering/audit failure; otherwise one coarse family and at most six local candidates, then freeze before holdout.

artifact_policy.signals: Not saved; deterministically recomputable from frozen raw data, feature source and candidate configuration hashes.

tuning_protocol.question: Can broader bounded daily parameters improve 24-session median and tails while satisfying every measured daily constraint?
tuning_protocol.hypothesis: Signal speed and diversification can improve robustness without increasing measured violations.
tuning_protocol.alternative: Execution/data/portfolio feasibility dominates; larger signal searches cannot certify this strategy.
tuning_protocol.screen: 12 equally spaced chronological monthly development episodes, endpoints included; identical for all candidates. No shuffled time splits.
tuning_protocol.promotion: Require 100% screen measured pass AND completeness for adoption. Ineligible configurations may seed explicitly diagnostic searches; they cannot be adopted.
tuning_protocol.phase_A: All 20 structural pairs; top 5 screen diagnostic regions retained.
tuning_protocol.phase_B: All valid return pairs plus all EMA and MACD tuples one family at a time around best structural region; other 4 regions receive 6 deterministic paired speed probes.
tuning_protocol.phase_C: All 19 meaningful replacement/margin combinations around B leader.
tuning_protocol.phase_D: All 42 score mixture combinations around C leader.
tuning_protocol.phase_E: One-factor sweep of all 25 declared risk/filter values around D leader; interactions probed by global search.
tuning_protocol.phase_F: Top 5 unique screened staged regions: full 2x2x2 Cartesian neighborhood of short return, long return and momentum. One bounded round; no further round absent validation improvement.
tuning_protocol.global: 48 unique seeded random draws from exact spec lists, seed 24092026.
tuning_protocol.shortlist: Up to 12: union of staged/local/global diagnostic leaders and highest-ranked screening candidates; full development then identical full validation. Include all screen-eligible candidates up to budget; disclose partial coverage.
tuning_protocol.stability: For the eligible validation leader, momentum +/-0.05 within bounds; full development and validation only. Both neighbors must pass and remain within 0.2 percentage point median/P25. Otherwise reject as fragile.
tuning_protocol.adoption: 100% measured pass AND completeness in FULL development and validation, validation median and P25 not worse than baseline; stable neighborhood required. Unknown official evidence always BLOCK_SUBMISSION.
tuning_protocol.freeze: If none eligible, freeze NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE with unchanged baseline reference. Do not fabricate a winner.
tuning_protocol.post_freeze: Baseline and frozen diagnostic method leaders on holdout/recent/seasonal; baseline/reference on last 126 available rolling starts. These are descriptive, never selection inputs.
tuning_protocol.prior_exposure: 2023-2024 and recent were already inspected in previous research. Isolated from this new search, not pristine unseen holdout. Baseline itself has earlier recent-period selection exposure.
tuning_protocol.stop: One bounded A-F/global study; no validation improvement or no eligible candidate stops refinement. Engineering/audit error stops execution.
tuning_protocol.failure_metrics: Return statistics conditional on complete measured-pass episodes; show all attempt counts, failures, completeness and compliance separately. Never use penalty scores as realized returns.
